CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DEP
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping
AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS [CustomerAccountId]
,BDG.BANK_ID AS [FinancialInstitutionId]
,BDG.ACID AS [CoreAccountId]
,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS [Timestamp]
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDGD.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CoreAccountId]
,[Timestamp]
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping WHERE RECORD_STATUS ='UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CoreAccountId]
,[Timestamp]
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountMapping WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'DEP'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[CoreAccountId] = SRC.CoreAccountId
,[Timestamp] = SRC.[Timestamp]
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountMapping TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId;


--INSERT TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountMapping
(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CoreAccountId]
,[Timestamp]
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,[WORKFLOWID]
,[TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]
)

SELECT
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CoreAccountId]
,[Timestamp]
,'DEP' AS [SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,0 AS [WORKFLOWID]
,0 AS [TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountMapping_DELTA;


END
